description: Source code implementing parsing and handling of cryptographic signature algorithms, including OID definitions, ASN.1 parsing, and RSA/ECDSA signature algorithm support within the Chromium project.

methods.name: ParseAlgorithmIdentifier
methods.description: Parses ASN.1 AlgorithmIdentifier, extracting OID and optional parameters.

methods.name: ParseHashAlgorithm
methods.description: Parses ASN.1 encoded hash algorithm identifier, mapping to DigestAlgorithm enum.

methods.name: ParseSignatureAlgorithm
methods.description: Parses ASN.1 signature algorithm identifier, returning SignatureAlgorithm enum.

methods.name: GetTlsServerEndpointDigestAlgorithm
methods.description: Determines the digest algorithm used for TLS server endpoint based on signature algorithm.

methods.name: ParseRsaPss
methods.description: Parses RSASSA-PSS parameters ASN.1 structure, supporting TLS 1.3 compatible configurations.
